convertibility_reason: Uses custom indicators (iCustom calls) for XROC2_VG, which are not built-in MT5 indicators. Requires the custom indicator .ex5 files to be available. Multi-timeframe logic with two different timeframe checks for confirmation.

other_exits: Signal reversal: opposite signal closes current position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM (money management) input is negative, use fixed lot size; if positive, use as percentage of deposit for lot calculation

custom_logic_notes: Dual-timeframe confirmation system: EA uses two separate timeframes (fast and slow, configurable) both running the same XROC2_VG custom indicator. Long entry requires XROC2_VG > 0 on both fast and slow timeframes. Short entry requires XROC2_VG < 0 on both fast and slow timeframes. Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one. SL/TP values are in points and multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of XROC2_VG custom indicator logic in Python. The dual-timeframe confirmation needs careful bar synchronization. SL/TP digit adjustment logic must be preserved. The conditional money management (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) must be replicated exactly.
